backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a media-sharing platform that handles video/photo uploads, user profiles, comments, likes, ratings, and access control using mixins for storage and authorization.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping four implemented features (Profile tab in nav, User Profile page, /profile route, view count threshold) to their source files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as documentation for the frontend codebase structure.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point that sets up Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including backgrounds, borders, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA titled 'MediaShare' that mounts the app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration with all application routes including /profile, wrapping pages in the Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a future Add to Playlist modal component.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button component that shows a sign-in button for unauthenticated users or a dropdown with the truncated principal and sign-out option for authenticated users via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five tabs (Home, Upload, Shorts, Subscriptions, Profile) using TanStack Router links with active-state highlighting via an indicator bar.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Component that fetches and displays a user's channel name (or truncated principal as fallback) as a clickable link navigating to the channel profile page.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment section for a video, allowing authenticated users to post comments and displaying existing comments with author info and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistMo: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a modal component to create playlists.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component providing a sticky header with search, upload, and auth buttons, a collapsible sidebar, bottom navigation, and a footer with social links.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a photo with a placeholder image, title, uploader channel name, and upload date, navigating to the photo detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to set up their profile by entering a name and optional channel name, saving the data via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: Button component that copies the current page URL to the clipboard and shows a toast notification on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Collapsible sidebar navigation with Home, Trending, and Library links, supporting a mobile overlay and closing on navigation for small screens.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: Input component for managing a list of tags, supporting adding tags via Enter or comma and removing them with a badge-based UI.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: Component that auto-generates video thumbnail candidates by seeking through the video at multiple positions and allows users to select one or upload a custom JPEG/PNG thumbnail.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: Displays a premium upgrade prompt card with feature highlights and a navigation button, shown only to free-tier users.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders a clickable video card in either default or compact variant, showing thumbnail, title, uploader, view count, and relative upload time.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: A dialog modal for editing video metadata (title, description, tags) and managing thumbnails, with tabbed navigation between details and thumbnail sections.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: A dropdown UI component for selecting video playback quality (auto, 360p–1080p), storing selection in local state without actual stream switching.
frontend/src/components/VideoRating.tsx: Interactive 5-star rating component that shows the user's current rating, supports hover preview, and submits ratings via the useRateVideo hook.
frontend/src/components/VideoRatingDispl: Read-only star rating display showing average rating with full/half/empty stars and total rating count fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: A card component for managing a video's thumbnail, allowing the user to view, change, or remove the current thumbnail via ThumbnailSelector.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook that submits a comment for a video via the actor and invalidates related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAverageRating.ts: Query hook that fetches the average star rating for a given video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: React Query hook that fetches a channel name for a given Principal from the backend actor, caching results for 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: React Query hook that fetches comments for a given video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the currently authenticated caller's user profile, with custom loading/fetched state that accounts for actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserRating.ts: React Query hook that retrieves the authenticated user's star rating for a specific video by searching their ratings list.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: React Query hook that returns the user's subscription status; currently hardcoded to return a free-tier response as a placeholder.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: Mutation hook that increments a video's view count for authenticated users and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: Mutation hook that marks a video's thumbnail as generated on the backend and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches a list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a photo file to the backend actor with progress tracking, returning upload state and progress percentage.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that submits a star rating for a video and invalidates all related rating and video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: Mutation hook that removes a video's thumbnail via the backend actor and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend and invalidates profile and channel name queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: React Query hook that searches videos by term, fetching full video data for each result from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: Mutation hook that validates and sets a channel name (3–30 characters) via the backend actor, invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: Mutation hook that uploads a custom thumbnail for a video with progress tracking and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: Mutation hook placeholder for subscribing to a channel; currently always throws an error as the backend feature is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: React Query hook that checks subscription status for a channel principal; currently returns false as a placeholder until backend support is added.
frontend/src/hooks/useTotalRatings.ts: React Query hook that fetches the total number of ratings for a given video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that updates a video's title, description, and tags via the backend actor and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: Mutation hook placeholder for upgrading a user account to premium; currently always throws an error as the backend feature is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: React Query hook that fetches user statistics for a given principal from the backend actor, caching results for 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single extended video by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: React Query mutation hook that likes a video via the backend actor, invalidates video caches, and shows toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: React Query hook that fetches the full list of video metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook that handles video file uploads to the backend with progress tracking, typed error handling, and toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Page component that displays a user's channel profile including their stats, uploaded videos, and photos, identified by a principal ID route parameter.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that fetches and displays all videos sorted by upload time in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Page component that displays a searchable, debounced-filtered grid of all uploaded photos.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Page component that displays a single photo by ID, converting its binary data to a blob URL for rendering alongside metadata.
frontend/src/pages/PlaylistDetail.tsx: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a playlist detail page.
frontend/src/pages/Playlists.tsx: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a playlists listing page.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's profile page including their stats, uploaded videos, and photos, with loading skeletons and an unauthenticated sign-in prompt.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides a settings page where authenticated users can update their display name and channel name, and view their current subscription tier.
frontend/src/pages/Shorts.tsx: Placeholder page for a Shorts feature that displays a 'Coming Soon' message with no functional content.
frontend/src/pages/Subscriptions.tsx: Placeholder page for channel subscriptions showing a 'Coming Soon' message for authenticated users or a sign-in prompt for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Displays a subscription upgrade page comparing Free and Premium tiers, allowing authenticated users to upgrade their account via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Photo upload page that lets authenticated users select an image file, enter a title and description, and submit it with upload progress feedback and a success state.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Video upload page supporting MP4/MOV/WebM/OGG files up to 500MB, with title, description, tags, thumbnail selection, upload progress, error handling, and retry functionality.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Displays a grid of all videos with a debounced search input that switches between full listing and search results. Handles loading and empty states with appropriate UI feedback.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Full video player page that streams a video, tracks authenticated watch time to increment view counts only after 5 seconds of real playback, and shows likes, subscriptions, comments, related videos, and an edit modal for owners.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides two utility functions: formatViewCount converts a bigint view count to a human-readable string (K/M/B), and formatTimeAgo converts a nanosecond timestamp to a relative time string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both regular and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (primary, secondary, chart, sidebar, etc.), custom border radii, Inter font family, and accordion keyframe animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest for MediaShare (a YouTube-like platform) tracking schema version, existing implemented features (profile tab, user profile page, view count threshold), and pending feature requests around profile sections and view count accuracy.
